name: Waters for Georgia
summary: Two-step grants (concept, then invited full proposal) for water quality, riparian and aquatic habitat restoration and barrier removal in selected regions of Georgia, USA. Open to nonprofits and governmental agencies.

geography.label: Georgia, USA (2027-2028 cycle: Coastal, Central and ACF/ACT regions)

pool.label: the 2027-2028 grant cycle
pool.note: Split between the regions selected for this cycle

calls.label: 2027-2028 grant cycle
calls.note: Concept stage was scheduled for August to October 2026; the page states no concept deadline

status.quote: Prospective applicants will submit a project concept August - October, 2026

pool.quote: Total funding for this cycle is expected to be $1,500,000.

administered_by.quote: The program is administered on behalf of the Georgia Power Foundation by the Bonneville Environmental Foundation (BEF)

applicant_types.quote: The Georgia Power Foundation considers proposals from: Governmental agencies Organizations with active 501(c)(3) tax status

geography.quote: For the current (2027-2028) grant cycle, projects must be within the following regions: Coastal Central ACF (Apalachicola-Chattahoochee-Flint) / ACT (Alabama-Coosa-Tallapoosa)

access.quote: Submittal of a project concept Based on the results of the project concept review, selected project proponents will be invited to submit a full proposal.

window.quote: Grant cycles occur every other year (odd years), and focuses on two-three regions within the state.
